intro: If you want a sea-view room in Cha-Am without a big budget, Asia Cha-am Hotel is one of the high-rise beachfront hotels guests mention most for its views and location · It's a 4-star, 214-room hotel about 200 metres from Cha-Am beach, an easy walk to the sand and the restaurants · The standout is its 17th-floor rooftop pool with sweeping sea views, plus a breakfast buffet guests praise · From approx. ฿1,200/night · This review is compiled from real guest reviews — both the praise and the honest gripes, because this is an older hotel whose scores are fairly split.

body.html: Asia Cha-am Hotel is a high-rise beachfront hotel on Cha-Am beach, on Ruamjit Alley in Cha-Am district, Phetchaburi · What guests mention most is the location and the sea views · It's around 200 metres from Cha-Am beach, an easy walk to the sand, the restaurants and the shopping strip, and its location category on Trip.com scores as high as 9.5 · It's a large, 214-room property in a classic high-rise style rather than a low-rise boutique resort — which suits anyone who likes being able to walk out to everything.

Rooms come in several types, from Executive Double, Executive Twin, Superior and Premier up to the Superior and Premier Sea View rooms that are the real draw here · Many reviews say the rooms are spacious, the beds comfortable, and that the private balcony is a nice spot to sit and look at the sea · If you want the sea view, choose a Deluxe/Premier Sea View room in the main tower — the Jacuzzi and Pool Room categories are in a different building and don't face the sea · It's worth checking this carefully at booking so you don't end up with a room that isn't what you pictured.

"Spacious, clean room with a comfortable bed and a beautiful sea view from the balcony · Easy walk to the beach and restaurants · Good breakfast with plenty of choice — great value for a view like this."

The hotel's biggest highlight is the 17th-floor rooftop pool with a lounge · It's a spot with sweeping views over the Cha-Am sea, and plenty of guests head up to take photos and relax in the evening · There's also a gym, a restaurant, a conference room and free private parking · The breakfast buffet is another frequently praised feature — both for its variety and the fresh-ground coffee some guests single out · For a hotel at this price point, the facilities are solid and genuinely usable.

On service, most guests praise the friendly, helpful staff, and the service category on Trip.com sits around 9.3 · Overall the hotel scores 9.1 out of 10 from 269 reviews on Trip.com, which is high · But to be honest, its scores are fairly split — on platforms like Tripadvisor it sits around the middle of the Cha-Am pack at 3 out of 5 stars · That gap reflects how much the experience depends on which room you get and what you expect going in.

The gripes in reviews mostly come down to it being an older, long-established hotel · Some rooms have aging, noisy air-conditioning, and a few guests noted a creaky bed or poor TV signal · Cleanliness and upkeep aren't always consistent, and some rooms clearly look newer than others · A few reviews felt certain rooms don't quite reach a full 4-star standard · Not everyone runs into these, but knowing them in advance helps you set expectations and pick a better room.

Another thing worth knowing is the uneven room condition · Because the hotel spans several buildings and a large number of rooms, quality varies quite a bit by floor and by when each room was last renovated · The smart move is to ask for a renovated room on a higher floor for the sea view when you book or check in · Get a well-kept room and the views and location here are great value; draw an older room and it may not feel like the high score you saw online.

Bottom line for anyone planning a Phetchaburi–Cha-Am trip · Asia Cha-am Hotel suits travellers who want a sea-view room and a walk-to-the-beach location at an accessible price, without needing a brand-new property · Its strengths are the beachfront location, the 17th-floor rooftop pool, a good breakfast and friendly service, from approx. ฿1,200/night · The trade-off is that it's an older hotel with uneven room condition · Pick a renovated room and set your expectations to the price, and it's a clear value choice on the Cha-Am beachfront.

honestSummary: Asia Cha-am Hotel is the beach hotel for travellers who want a sea-view room and a walk-to-the-beach location at an accessible price · Its strengths are the beachfront location, the 17th-floor rooftop pool, a good breakfast and friendly service · The trade-off is that it's an older, long-established hotel with uneven room condition and some aging fittings · Pick a renovated room and set expectations to the price, and it's a standout value on the Cha-Am beachfront.
honestChecks: If you expect a brand-new, full 4-star hotel — this is an older tower with uneven room condition and some aging fittings → ask for a renovated room when you book, or choose a newer resort in the area if your budget allows

If you're here mainly for the sea view — the Jacuzzi and Pool Room categories are in a different building with no sea view → choose a Superior/Premier Sea View room on a higher floor of the main tower to get the view you came for
If you're a light sleeper — some reviews found noisy old air-con or a creaky bed → ask the front desk to move rooms at check-in; staff here are helpful about it

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Asia Cha-am Hotel, Cha-Am

faq.q: Where is Asia Cha-am Hotel, and what's nearby?
faq.a: It sits on Ruamjit Alley, on the Cha-Am beachfront in Cha-Am, Phetchaburi · It's around 200 metres from Cha-Am beach, an easy walk to the sand · The Cha-Am night market is about a 5-minute walk · Mrigadayavan Palace is around 12 minutes, and Hua Hin town about 25–30 minutes by car.

faq.q: How much does Asia Cha-am Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿1,200/night for a Superior Room · Options include Superior/Premier Sea View rooms, Executive Double/Twin and family rooms · If you want the sea view, choose a Sea View room in the main tower · Rates vary by season and package, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Asia Cha-am Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for couples and families who want a sea-view room and a walk-to-the-beach location at an accessible price · It suits travellers who like wandering the beachfront and the Cha-Am night market more than staying put in a quiet resort, and who don't need a brand-new property.

faq.q: What review score does Asia Cha-am Hotel have?
faq.a: It's rated 9.1 out of 10 on Trip.com from 269 reviews, with location scoring as high as 9.5 and service around 9.3 · On Tripadvisor it sits around the middle of the Cha-Am pack at 3 out of 5 stars · Its scores are fairly split because room condition is uneven and depends on the room you get.

faq.q: What is the pool at Asia Cha-am Hotel like?
faq.a: It's a rooftop pool on the 17th floor with a lounge · It has sweeping views over the Cha-Am sea, and plenty of guests head up for photos and to relax in the evening · It's a standout feature that the other high-rise beach hotels in the area don't really offer.

faq.q: Are the rooms at Asia Cha-am Hotel old?
faq.a: It's a long-established hotel, so room condition is uneven and some rooms look newer than others · A few reviews found aging, noisy air-con or poor TV signal · It's worth asking for a renovated room at booking or check-in — get a well-kept one and the sea views and location are great value.
